scope: Applicable-Seek gate: full host seek on the real OpenGL backend at two replay sizes. Diagnostic/test-only. It covers the repeated hot-reuse and cold-process classes; it says nothing about external archive certification, natural checkpoint first use or the no-checkpoint fallback.

instrument.note: added in this batch: host pause -> replayCut -> seek -> sample -> present on the device renderer, with host capacity sized for a repeated-seek loop

boundary: request -> replayCut + seek return (request_to_ready_us); request -> target frame present return (request_to_present_us)
statistics: per process: median and max over 16 seeks; per replay size: max across processes decides
